name: Sync Churn Watch
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Redraws the watch view at most two times each second during bulk edits.
Adds free watch sessions, settings checks, note event counts and Markdown copy.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
During bulk edits, the watch view redraws at most twice a second, so it stays usable.
The watch view keeps its scroll position and open session history after a settings check.
tip: Run Copy results as Markdown to put a write table on the clipboard.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Sync Churn Watch is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your sync history in check.
